title: Why TSMC Is Letting Go of CoWoS—and Where Its Real Second Moat Lies
author: Daniel Nenni
text:

TSMC has spent years building CoWoS into an almost unassailable position in AI chip packaging. So why is it now willing to let ASE and Amkor take a bigger piece of the business?

The answer may reveal where TSMC believes its real technological moat lies.

As CoWoS-like packaging spreads across the industry, TSMC is shifting its focus toward SoIC, a far more demanding 3D stacking technology that Nvidia is expected to adopt for its future Feynman GPU. Meanwhile, ASE is pouring billions into advanced packaging, Amkor is bringing CoWoS to the U.S., and even Intel’s EMIB-T is breaking into territory once dominated by TSMC.

TSMC isn’t walking away from advanced packaging. It may simply be deciding which battlefield is worth defending.
